holdout.rule: strict: fields this model never saw in training or validation; deduplicated curated ground truth of 2026-10-11 (gt_rescore_20261011)

scores.pooling: micro-average over all test fields: object F1, precision and recall from summed TP/FP/FN (spacr.scorecard.match_objects, IoU >= 0.5); AJI = sum C / sum U (Kumar 2017); Dice = 2 sum |T and P| / sum (|T| + |P|) over foreground pixels; boundary F1 from summed boundary-pixel hits at 2 px tolerance (spacr.scorecard._boundary).

rows.label: Domains
rows.stock: General cell and nucleus images (Cellpose datasets)

about.segments: Toxoplasma gondii parasitophorous vacuoles (PVs) in fluorescence images of infected host cells, with the parasite marked by DsRed or an anti-Toxoplasma stain.
about.trained_on: 285 curated fields (lab immunofluorescence and DsRed fields plus published-figure crops), split 202 train / 33 validation / 50 test by acquisition and paper.
about.status: Alternative, not the default. The default PV model in spaCR is toxoplasma_pv_v4.
about.leak_note: PV v5 trained or validated on 29 of the 39 literature hold-out fields and on 3 of the 11 anchor wells. Those fields are left out of its test set on page 1, so its scores come from fields it never saw, but it cannot be compared with v1 to v4 on the literature hold-out or the anchors.
about.load_line: Set `pathogen_model_name` to `toxoplasma_pv_v5`; spaCR downloads and checks the weights on first use.
